reason: W364 (#426): x'=a+x^2 has a fold at x=a=0; the transverse pair b +/- i crosses the imaginary axis at b=0. Continuing the fold in b and a therefore passes a zero-Hopf point with spectrum 0,+i,-i. AUTO-07p 0.9.4 labels the same ZH (zero_hopf.auto07p).

differences.cause: XPPAUT 8.0's auto_2p_limit sets ISP=0 and ILP=0, disabling detection on the curve (auto_nox.c:2510-2512); the curve is still compared. W428 (#490), docs/xppaut-findings.md finding 71.
